P.flaw: A large empty gap above the button makes the layout feel unfinished, and the deadline is set in light body weight, so it is easy to miss.

Q.flaw: The bordered Window and copay boxes look like tappable buttons, which could confuse an older user.

ui-1.why_top: Q has a stronger hierarchy: a solid header band, a larger order number, emphasised window, copay and deadline, and it uses the screen fully while meeting every constraint.

P.flaw: The amber Cancel alarm is the loudest element on the screen and sits above the destination, which inverts the hierarchy and invites attention to the risky action.

Q.flaw: Snooze is bare text with no visible target, so its 56 pt hit area is unclear, and the current time looks like a system status bar.

ui-2.why_top: Q makes the amber 7 min clearly dominant in the dim cabin and guards Cancel alarm with press-and-hold in a hard-to-reach top corner, while Snooze stays clearly quieter.
